title: Mrugaalaya
desc: Vijay Kumar notices illegal activities taking place at the zoo where he works and fights against them in order to conserve wild animals.

title: G.O.A.T
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Akhanda 2
desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: #Single
desc: Vijay enjoys his single life until he falls for Purva. While pursuing her, he discovers that Harini, his friend, loves him and inadvertently gets caught in a love triangle.

title: DD Returns
desc: An event manager and his friends hide the money they stole in a haunted bungalow to evade the police but when they go back to retrieve it, the ghosts force them to play a dangerous game.
